assessment.nobel_worthiness: Visionary, densely patterned prose that makes memory, the body and cosmology into one large imaginative project. Public knowledge of Blinding (the Orbitor trilogy) and Solenoid suggests a highly distinctive voice, formal ambition and metaphysical depth. The work is rooted in the Romanian language and also draws on the European modernist and fantastic traditions.
assessment.attribution: A citation would cover the novelistic oeuvre, with poetry and essays as a secondary foundation. The credit is to a single writer and the scope is clear.
assessment.maturity: Decades of sustained work from the poetry of the 1980s to the large late novels, with consistent ambition and no obvious decline. The main novels are long, so the case rests on the whole body of work and not on any single book.
uncertainties: Translation of long, linguistically dense Romanian prose may flatten stylistic effects, so I cannot independently confirm how much of the voice survives in translation.
I have not verified the texts myself and my sense of the poetry and essays is thinner than of the novels.
The late novels are very long, and the evenness of their quality is hard to judge from a general overview.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A radically inward fiction with a very recognizable voice. It builds its own system of landscape, memory and mental images, as in The Plains and Border Districts, with great formal consistency and an austere, self-questioning syntax. Its imaginative and intellectual depth is high and its influence is concentrated and intense.
assessment.attribution: The citation would cover a fiction oeuvre of a deliberately narrow, self-referential kind. The credit is to one writer with no ambiguity.
assessment.maturity: A long career with a late consolidation of reputation and a remarkable late-period output. The body of work is stylistically coherent and sustained, though thematically narrow by design.
uncertainties: The breadth of significance beyond a committed readership is uncertain.
The scope of the work is narrow and I cannot judge from general knowledge whether it would be regarded as a universal contribution.
I have not independently verified the corpus and rely on public overviews.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dense, compressed French prose that turns obscure lives and art history into narrative inquiry, as in Small Lives and The Eleven. The stylistic intensity, the control of syntax and the combination of historical imagination with a meditation on literary vocation are all of a high order.
assessment.attribution: A citation would cover the short-form prose narratives as a unified project on the making of lives and of art. The credit is to a single writer.
assessment.maturity: A compact oeuvre of high quality and consistency over several decades. Its small size is a feature of the method but a limit on the weight of the corpus.
uncertainties: The style depends heavily on the French language and is difficult to translate, so reception in other languages may under-represent it.
The small number of works offers a narrower base for the criterion of sustained, wide-ranging achievement.
I have not verified the texts independently.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large, polyphonic narratives, notably Carpentaria and The Swan Book, that remake the novel through Indigenous oral forms, sovereignty and ecological time. The scale, the invented narrative idiom and the political-historical imagination are strong. I judge the merit on narrative form and language and not on the political significance of the subject.
assessment.attribution: A citation would cover the novels together with the nonfiction (including the collective memoir of Tracker Tilmouth). The credit is to a single writer, though the work draws on collective storytelling traditions.
assessment.maturity: Fewer major novels than some rivals, though each is large and ambitious. The oeuvre is still developing, so a case for sustained achievement is solid but less complete than for the longest careers.
uncertainties: The size of the fiction corpus is modest, which weakens the case on depth of oeuvre.
The idiom draws on Aboriginal English and oral traditions that I cannot assess in detail.
I have not independently verified the works.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dreamlike narrative worlds that destabilize psychology, space and causality, as in Frontier and Love in the New Millennium. The voice is unmistakable and uncompromising, and its relation to Kafka-like and modernist traditions is personal and non-derivative. The formal radicalism is high.
assessment.attribution: A citation would cover the experimental fiction, with the stories and the critical writing as support. The credit is to a single writer.
assessment.maturity: A career of over four decades with consistent aesthetic commitment. The uniformity of the method makes it hard to say whether depth increases or the same procedure repeats.
uncertainties: Translation of a highly abstract and idiosyncratic Chinese style is a considerable uncertainty and the English versions may not convey the prose.
It is hard to judge differences in quality between the works from public knowledge.
I have not verified the texts independently.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A hybrid of travel writing, essay and fiction that maps Europe through borderlands, memory and intellectual history. Danube and Microcosms show erudition, a flexible and distinctive prose and a seriousness about European culture. It is a significant body of work, though its center of gravity is the essay-novel hybrid and not narrative invention.
assessment.attribution: A citation would cover the genre-crossing prose and the cultural-historical writing. The credit is to a single writer.
assessment.maturity: A long and consistent career with an established standing. Some of the strongest work belongs to an earlier period, and the question is whether the later work adds to it.
uncertainties: The weight of the essays and scholarship against the imaginative work is unclear to me.
How well the Italian prose and its erudite references travel in translation is uncertain.
I have not independently verified the works.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Remade Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and sustained dialogue with inherited forms, as in Songs of Mihyar the Damascene. Its formal and linguistic achievement and its influence within Arabic poetry are widely recognized. The critical essays on tradition add intellectual depth.
assessment.attribution: A citation would cover the poetry as the core, with the critical and theoretical essays as a second element. The credit is to a single writer.
assessment.maturity: An oeuvre of more than six decades with a long record of influence. The later work is voluminous and I cannot say how consistent it is.
uncertainties: Poetry is the form that loses most in translation, so my judgment is limited by the available versions.
The volume of later work makes it hard to assess evenness of quality.
I have not independently verified the works.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Linguistic invention that brings oral storytelling, neologism and Mozambican speech into novels of war, memory and postcolonial life, as in Sleepwalking Land and Confession of the Lioness. The voice is distinctive and the language work is a real achievement. The imaginative scope is wide, though the later work may be more uneven than the earlier.
assessment.attribution: A citation would cover the novels and stories, with the poetry as a secondary part. The credit is to a single writer.
assessment.maturity: A long and productive career since the 1980s. Sustained quality is plausible, but I cannot confirm how well the middle and later works hold up compared with the best-known novels.
uncertainties: Much of the achievement lies in the invented Portuguese, which is hard to render in translation.
Coverage of the full corpus in translation is incomplete.
I have not independently verified the texts.
